label: Acts attests a Christian community at Pisidian Antioch

date.note: Paul's first missionary journey per the Pauline chronology Acts presupposes; Acts itself was composed c. 80–90, a generation later (hence the retrospective grade).

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: Pisidian Antioch (Colonia Caesarea, at Yalvaç), not one of the many other Antiochs; Pleiades 609307. Acts 14.21–23 has Paul and Barnabas appoint elders in each of these churches on the return leg, implying an organized community.
